decision: I removed duplicate rows and kept the first one.
reason: Duplicate rows repeat the same patient information and alter the data and make it inaccurate.

issue: gender spellings that are not a code
decision: I converted gender values to F, M, or X and made the unknown values missing.
reason: having all the same gender codes makes the data easier to analyze.

decision: I changed site codes to uppercase and removed spaces and hyphens.
reason: having a standardized site codes allow the tables to match properly.
9999 represents is a missing birth year and not a real year.

issue: weight column named wt_kg in visits_south.csv
reason: Both visit files need the same column names before combining.

issue: sbp sentinel 999 and readings outside 70 through 250
decision: I replaced invalid blood pressure readings with missing values.
reason: Invalid blood pressure values should not be used in the analysis.

issue: impossible and loosely written visit dates
decision: I converted valid dates and made invalid dates missing.
reason: I did this so everything would be consistent.

decision: I kept the later visit reading for repeated pairs.
reason: The later reading is the recheck for that visit.
This is so there weren't mutiple rows with the same info.
